workbookTitle: Quick check: did this actually help you move forward?
workbookText: I am actively improving Made2Found - your feedback helps make the tool genuinely better.
dialogText: I really appreciate your feedback - especially what helped, what felt unclear, and what is still missing.
requiredError: Please answer the first three questions first. They are the most important ones for me.
invalidError: Please check your answers once more.
saveError: Feedback could not be saved right now.

questions.q1: 1. What was the most valuable moment for you in the tool?
questions.q2: 2. Where did it feel unclear or unnecessarily complicated?
questions.q3: 3. What would need to change for you to say: this really helped me?
questions.q4: 4. Where would you want more support?
questions.q5: 5. Is there anything else you would like to tell me?

requiredHint: The first three questions are especially important for me; everything else is optional.
nameNotice: Your name is stored with the feedback and only read by the founder.

panel.title: Your feedback
panel.subtitle: One sentence is enough. I read everything myself.
panel.genericQuestion: What would you like to tell me?
panel.genericHint: Choose above what it is about – then the question fits.

help.name: This helped
help.question: What helped you here?
help.placeholder: e.g. the overview, a sentence, a step …
help.hint: It shows me what I must not change.

unclear.name: This was unclear
unclear.question: Where did you get stuck or not understand something?
unclear.hint: In your own words: what did you expect, what did you find?

bug.name: There is a bug
bug.question: What did you want to do, and what happened?
bug.hint: If you can: what did you click last? It saves me the search.

missing.name: Something is missing
missing.question: What is missing here, and what would it help you with?
missing.placeholder: I would like to be able to … in order to …
missing.hint: An example from your day is worth more than a list of features.

panel.importance: How important is this to you?
panel.contactTitle: You may write to me about this.
panel.contactText: Only for follow-up questions about this feedback. Without the tick I only read.
panel.kindRequired: Please choose above what it is about.
panel.thanksText: I read it personally. If you allowed me to write to you and I want to know something, I will get in touch.
